title: CT National Guard Rescues Dog Stranded On A Roof Top During Hurricane Florence
description: Soldiers with the Connecticut National Guard rescue a dog stranded on a roof during a Search and Rescue mission in the aftermath of Hurricane Florence. Connecticut is one of 13 states who supplied aviation assets to the N.C. National Guard to support in the recovery efforts.
keywords: citizen soldier, National Guard, army, North Carolina
unit_name: Headquarters Detachment, NCNG Joint Force Headquarters

transcript.text: - We were flying around,
looking for signs of life in some of houses.
Some people kind of waved us off,
indicating they did not need assistance.
Then we saw a dog on a rooftop
and it didn't look like anybody was in the area.
We actually lowered the Swift Water Rescue swimmer
down to check it out.
He didn't see any owner, so he picked up the dog,
and then he has a special harness for the dog,
for the dog's safety and for his safety,
was able to ride up the hoist with the dog.
Then we were able to lower him to safety
after we got him into the aircraft
and got him safely secured.
Don't know who the owner was
or where that dog came from,
but we're happy to get him to dry land
so that he wasn't just stuck on top of rooftop
'cause it's hot and he's got nowhere to go.
So the whole area was just completely flooded.
So I don't know if that dog would have made it otherwise.
